response.justification: This candidate is a poor fit for the role. The position requires 5-10 years of professional C++ development on Windows platforms, but the resume shows only ~6 months of professional C++ experience at National Instruments (2014-2015), with the vast majority of the career focused on web development using TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang. There is no demonstrated Windows platform expertise, no SQL Server or Oracle experience, and critically, zero exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains. While the candidate demonstrates strong engineering practices and communication skills, the fundamental mandatory technical requirements cannot be satisfied.
strengths: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrated through multiple technical workshops, talks, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
Strong DevOps and CI/CD pipeline expertise with GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment infrastructure
Proven ability to work across multiple programming languages and technical domains with professional Java experience
concerns: Critically insufficient C++ experience: only ~6 months of documented professional work versus the required 5-10 years
No evidence of Windows platform development expertise; career primarily focused on web backends, Linux, and cloud environments
Complete absence of capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain knowledge
